parameters.subject: =🔧 Predictive Maintenance Alert — {{ $json.count }} Components at Risk

parameters.query: SELECT f.id, f.rigId, f.title, f.status, f.severity, r.name as rigName FROM failures f JOIN rigs r ON r.id = f.rigId WHERE f.isRemoved = 0 AND f.status NOT IN ('closed') AND f.dueDate < DATEADD(DAY, 7, GETDATE()) AND f.dueDate >= GETDATE() ORDER BY f.severity ASC, f.dueDate ASC
